measure: a span of time between two timestamps
naive_sql:
WITH trip_gaps AS (
  SELECT
    t.bike_id,
    CAST(
      julianday(t.started_at) - julianday(
        LAG(t.ended_at) OVER (
          PARTITION BY t.bike_id
          ORDER BY t.started_at
        )
      ) AS REAL
    ) AS gap_days
  FROM trips AS t
),
maintenance_gaps AS (
  SELECT
    m.bike_id,
    CAST(
      julianday(m.reported_at) - julianday(
        LAG(m.completed_at) OVER (
          PARTITION BY m.bike_id
          ORDER BY m.reported_at
        )
      ) AS REAL
    ) AS gap_days
  FROM maintenance AS m
),
trip_gap_stats AS (
  SELECT
    bike_id,
    AVG(gap_days) AS avg_days_between_trips
  FROM trip_gaps
  GROUP BY bike_id
),
maintenance_gap_stats AS (
  SELECT
    bike_id,
    AVG(gap_days) AS avg_days_between_maintenance_jobs
  FROM maintenance_gaps
  GROUP BY bike_id
)
SELECT
  b.bike_id AS bike_id,
  tgs.avg_days_between_trips AS avg_days_between_trips,
  mgs.avg_days_between_maintenance_jobs AS avg_days_between_maintenance_jobs
FROM bikes AS b
JOIN trip_gap_stats AS tgs
  ON tgs.bike_id = b.bike_id
JOIN maintenance_gap_stats AS mgs
  ON mgs.bike_id = b.bike_id
ORDER BY b.bike_id
gold_sql:
WITH trip_gaps AS (

        )

    ) AS gap_days
  FROM bikes AS b

    ON t.bike_id = b.bike_id
),
maintenance_gaps AS (

          ORDER BY m.reported_at
        )
      ) AS REAL

trip_gap_stats AS (

  COALESCE(tgs.avg_days_between_trips, 0) AS avg_days_between_trips,

LEFT JOIN trip_gap_stats AS tgs

WITH maintenance_counts AS (

    COUNT(m.job_id) AS maintenance_job_count

  LEFT JOIN maintenance AS m
    ON m.bike_id = b.bike_id

SELECT
  bm.model_id AS model_id,

measure: a per-unit rate (per day, per member, per km)
naive_sql:
SELECT
  t.technician_id AS technician_id,
  t.technician_name AS technician_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT b.bike_id) AS total_bikes,
  COUNT(m.job_id) AS completed_jobs,
  ROUND(COUNT(m.job_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT b.bike_id), 0), 6) AS completed_jobs_per_bike
FROM technicians AS t
JOIN maintenance AS m
  ON m.technician_id = t.technician_id
 AND m.completed_at IS NOT NULL
JOIN bikes AS b
  ON b.bike_id = m.bike_id
GROUP BY
  t.technician_id,
  t.technician_name
ORDER BY
  completed_jobs_per_bike DESC,
  technician_id
gold_sql:
WITH technician_bike_counts AS (
  SELECT
    t.technician_id,
    t.technician_name,
    COUNT(b.bike_id) AS total_bikes
  FROM technicians AS t
  LEFT JOIN bikes AS b
    ON 1 = 1
  GROUP BY
    t.technician_id,
    t.technician_name
),
technician_completed_jobs AS (
  SELECT
    t.technician_id,
    COUNT(m.job_id) AS completed_jobs
  FROM technicians AS t
  LEFT JOIN maintenance AS m
    ON m.technician_id = t.technician_id
   AND m.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.technician_id
)
SELECT
  tbc.technician_id AS technician_id,
  tbc.technician_name AS technician_name,
  tbc.total_bikes AS total_bikes,
  COALESCE(tcj.completed_jobs, 0) AS completed_jobs,
  ROUND(COALESCE(tcj.completed_jobs, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(tbc.total_bikes, 0), 6) AS completed_jobs_per_bike
FROM technician_bike_counts AS tbc
LEFT JOIN technician_completed_jobs AS tcj
  ON tcj.technician_id = tbc.technician_id
ORDER BY
  completed_jobs_per_bike DESC,
  technician_id

measure: a running or cumulative total over an ordering
naive_sql:
SELECT
  t.technician_id AS technician_id,
  t.technician_name AS technician_name,
  substr(m.reported_at, 1, 7) AS report_month,
  COUNT(m.job_id) AS jobs_in_month,
  SUM(COUNT(m.job_id)) OVER (
    PARTITION BY t.technician_id
    ORDER BY substr(m.reported_at, 1, 7)
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS cumulative_jobs_through_month
FROM technicians AS t
JOIN maintenance AS m
  ON m.technician_id = t.technician_id
GROUP BY
  t.technician_id,
  t.technician_name,
  substr(m.reported_at, 1, 7)
ORDER BY
  t.technician_id,
  report_month
gold_sql:
WITH monthly_jobs AS (
  SELECT
    t.technician_id,
    t.technician_name,
    substr(m.reported_at, 1, 7) AS report_month,
    COUNT(m.job_id) AS jobs_in_month
  FROM technicians AS t
  LEFT JOIN maintenance AS m
    ON m.technician_id = t.technician_id
  GROUP BY
    t.technician_id,
    t.technician_name,
    substr(m.reported_at, 1, 7)
),
monthly_jobs_non_null AS (
  SELECT
    technician_id,
    technician_name,
    report_month,
    jobs_in_month
  FROM monthly_jobs
  WHERE report_month IS NOT NULL
),
technician_month_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    technician_id,
    technician_name,
    MIN(report_month) AS first_month,
    MAX(report_month) AS last_month
  FROM monthly_jobs_non_null
  GROUP BY
    technician_id,
    technician_name
),
recursive_months AS (
  SELECT
    technician_id,
    technician_name,
    first_month AS report_month,
    last_month
  FROM technician_month_bounds
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    technician_id,
    technician_name,
    strftime('%Y-%m', date(report_month || '-01', '+1 month')) AS report_month,
    last_month
  FROM recursive_months
  WHERE report_month < last_month
),
technician_month_series AS (
  SELECT
    technician_id,
    technician_name,
    report_month
  FROM recursive_months
)
SELECT
  tms.technician_id AS technician_id,
  tms.technician_name AS technician_name,
  tms.report_month AS report_month,
  COALESCE(mjn.jobs_in_month, 0) AS jobs_in_month,
  SUM(COALESCE(mjn.jobs_in_month, 0)) OVER (
    PARTITION BY tms.technician_id
    ORDER BY tms.report_month
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS cumulative_jobs_through_month
FROM technician_month_series AS tms
LEFT JOIN monthly_jobs_non_null AS mjn
  ON mjn.technician_id = tms.technician_id
 AND mjn.report_month = tms.report_month
ORDER BY
  tms.technician_id,
  tms.report_month

measure: a maximum or minimum, with the row that attains it
naive_sql:
WITH member_trip_counts AS (
  SELECT
    m.member_id,
    COUNT(t.trip_id) AS trip_count
  FROM members AS m
  JOIN trips AS t
    ON t.member_id = m.member_id
  GROUP BY m.member_id
),
ranked_members AS (
  SELECT
    member_id,
    trip_count,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY trip_count ASC, member_id ASC) AS trip_count_rank
  FROM member_trip_counts
)
SELECT
  rm.member_id AS member_id,
  rm.trip_count AS min_trip_count
FROM ranked_members AS rm
WHERE rm.trip_count_rank = 1

measure: a running or cumulative total over an ordering
naive_sql:
SELECT
  t.technician_id AS technician_id,
  t.technician_name AS technician_name,
  substr(m.reported_at, 1, 7) AS month,
  SUM(m.cost_cents) AS monthly_maintenance_cost_cents,
  SUM(SUM(m.cost_cents)) OVER (
    PARTITION BY t.technician_id
    ORDER BY substr(m.reported_at, 1, 7)
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS running_maintenance_cost_cents
FROM technicians AS t
JOIN maintenance AS m
  ON m.technician_id = t.technician_id
GROUP BY
  t.technician_id,
  t.technician_name,
  substr(m.reported_at, 1, 7)
ORDER BY
  technician_id,
  month
gold_sql:
WITH monthly_costs AS (
  SELECT
    t.technician_id,
    t.technician_name,
    substr(m.reported_at, 1, 7) AS month,
    SUM(m.cost_cents) AS monthly_maintenance_cost_cents
  FROM technicians AS t
  LEFT JOIN maintenance AS m
    ON m.technician_id = t.technician_id
  GROUP BY
    t.technician_id,
    t.technician_name,
    substr(m.reported_at, 1, 7)
),
monthly_costs_no_null_month AS (
  SELECT
    technician_id,
    technician_name,
    month,
    COALESCE(monthly_maintenance_cost_cents, 0) AS monthly_maintenance_cost_cents
  FROM monthly_costs
  WHERE month IS NOT NULL
),
all_technicians AS (
  SELECT
    technician_id,
    technician_name
  FROM technicians
  WHERE technician_id NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT technician_id
    FROM maintenance
    WHERE technician_id IS NOT NULL
  )
),
running_costs_with_jobs AS (
  SELECT
    technician_id,
    technician_name,
    month,
    monthly_maintenance_cost_cents,
    SUM(monthly_maintenance_cost_cents) OVER (
      PARTITION BY technician_id
      ORDER BY month
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS running_maintenance_cost_cents
  FROM monthly_costs_no_null_month
)
SELECT
  r.technician_id AS technician_id,
  r.technician_name AS technician_name,
  r.month AS month,
  r.monthly_maintenance_cost_cents AS monthly_maintenance_cost_cents,
  r.running_maintenance_cost_cents AS running_maintenance_cost_cents
FROM running_costs_with_jobs AS r

UNION ALL

SELECT
  a.technician_id AS technician_id,
  a.technician_name AS technician_name,
  NULL AS month,
  0 AS monthly_maintenance_cost_cents,
  0 AS running_maintenance_cost_cents
FROM all_technicians AS a

ORDER BY
  technician_id,
  month

measure: a label assigned by thresholds on a computed quantity
naive_sql:
SELECT
  b.borough_id AS borough_id,
  b.borough_name AS borough_name,
  COUNT(w.day) AS weather_day_count,
  COUNT(t.technician_id) AS technician_hire_count,
  ROUND(
    1.0 * COUNT(t.technician_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(w.day), 0),
    6
  ) AS technicians_per_weather_day,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(w.day) = 0 THEN 'no_weather_data'
    WHEN 1.0 * COUNT(t.technician_id) / COUNT(w.day) >= 0.020 THEN 'high'
    WHEN 1.0 * COUNT(t.technician_id) / COUNT(w.day) >= 0.010 THEN 'medium'
    ELSE 'low'
  END AS technician_density_label
FROM boroughs AS b
JOIN technicians AS t
  ON t.depot_borough_id = b.borough_id
JOIN weather_daily AS w
  ON w.borough_id = b.borough_id
GROUP BY
  b.borough_id,
  b.borough_name
ORDER BY b.borough_id
gold_sql:
WITH weather_days_per_borough AS (
  SELECT
    b.borough_id,
    b.borough_name,
    COUNT(w.day) AS weather_day_count
  FROM boroughs AS b
  LEFT JOIN weather_daily AS w
    ON w.borough_id = b.borough_id
  GROUP BY
    b.borough_id,
    b.borough_name
),
tech_hires_per_borough AS (
  SELECT
    b.borough_id,
    COUNT(t.technician_id) AS technician_hire_count
  FROM boroughs AS b
  LEFT JOIN technicians AS t
    ON t.depot_borough_id = b.borough_id
  GROUP BY b.borough_id
)
SELECT
  wdb.borough_id AS borough_id,
  wdb.borough_name AS borough_name,
  wdb.weather_day_count AS weather_day_count,
  thb.technician_hire_count AS technician_hire_count,
  ROUND(
    1.0 * thb.technician_hire_count / NULLIF(wdb.weather_day_count, 0),
    6
  ) AS technicians_per_weather_day,
  CASE
    WHEN wdb.weather_day_count = 0 THEN 'no_weather_data'
    WHEN 1.0 * thb.technician_hire_count / wdb.weather_day_count >= 0.020 THEN 'high'
    WHEN 1.0 * thb.technician_hire_count / wdb.weather_day_count >= 0.010 THEN 'medium'
    ELSE 'low'
  END AS technician_density_label
FROM weather_days_per_borough AS wdb
JOIN tech_hires_per_borough AS thb
  ON thb.borough_id = wdb.borough_id
ORDER BY wdb.borough_id
